topic: How does nonlinear power amplifier operation influence payload power management during EE-maximizing precoding?
consensus_response: Nonlinear power amplifier operation significantly impacts payload power management during EE-maximizing precoding by introducing intermodulation products, degrading signal quality and efficiency. The high-power amplifier's nonlinearity combined with channelization filters' memory effects generates inter-symbol interference (ISI), reducing system throughput over total power consumption. To mitigate these effects, digital predistortion techniques can be integrated into precoding algorithms to optimize power allocation and minimize distortion.
